candidates.change_summary: Return true unconditionally from paused() instead of reading the stored paused flag.
Return false unconditionally from paused() instead of reading the stored paused flag.
Return the negation of the stored paused flag from paused().
Replace the IAccessControl interface-id check with the IERC165 interface-id check so supportsInterface(type(IAccessControl).interfaceId) returns true instead of false.
Negate the IAccessControl interface-id equality check, flippling which interfaceId values return true versus false.
Replace the super.supportsInterface(interfaceId) term with a constant false, so supportsInterface(type(IERC165).interfaceId) returns false instead of true.
The `hasRole` function is modified to return `false` whenever the role is `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE`, changing the observable return value for that role.
